notes: The authorisation check asks the subject of the check for the answer: `from` is caller-supplied, and `require(IVisor(from).owner() == msg.sender)` reads `owner()` from a contract the caller may have deployed, so the guard is satisfiable by construction. Not unchecked_external_call: `delegatedTransferERC20` is declared `external` returning nothing, so there is no return value to inspect -- the class the post-mortem phrasing suggests does not apply, which reading the interface settled.
